paragraphs: Corporater sells enterprise software that brings governance, performance, risk and compliance together in one system. The company aims the platform at medium and large organizations, including multinational groups working across several regions and regulatory environments.

At the center is a digital model of the organization that connects strategy, processes, risks, controls, KPIs and policies instead of leaving them spread across separate tools. Customers assemble solutions from configurable business objects rather than commissioning custom development. Processes handled on the platform include strategic planning, enterprise risk management, internal audit, policy and incident management, ESG reporting and business continuity. A conversational assistant named TIVA lets users register risks, complete compliance tasks and trigger workflows by asking in plain language.

Buyers can run the platform as SaaS, on their own premises, or in a private cloud. The company describes customers in regulated industries across more than fifty countries. It states that the platform is VL5 Veracode Verified. Its work on digital twins of an organization has been named in Gartner market guides, according to the site.

quote.text: A GPRC (Governance, Performance, Risk, and Compliance) platform connects governance, strategy execution, performance management, risk management, and compliance within a single enterprise system.
